With the fix, `![x\"x](x)` under `-x smarty` now gives `

`, the same output as `![x"x](x)`. Nothing is committed. **Cause:** when you backslash-escape a character, Markdown swaps it for a placeholder. A postprocessor turned the placeholders back into characters only *after* the HTML had been written out, so nothing escaped them. The smarty extension adds `"` and `'` to the escapable characters, so `\"` came back as a bare `"` inside the attribute. **Fix:** - **`markdown/treeprocessors.py`:** a new `UnescapeTreeprocessor` (registered as `unescape`, priority 0, so it runs after `inline` and `prettify`). It restores the characters in element text, tails and attribute values *before* the HTML is written out, so they get escaped properly. Text inside `code` elements is left alone. - **`markdown/postprocessors.py`:** `UnescapePostprocessor` is no longer registered by default. Using it now raises a `DeprecationWarning`. - **`markdown/extensions/toc.py`:** its `unescape()` helper now uses the new treeprocessor instead of the deprecated postprocessor. - **Docs:** I updated the processor tables in `docs/extensions/api.md` and added a section to `docs/change_log/release-3.4.md`. **One visible change in output:** `\>` now renders as `>` instead of a bare `>`. Both are valid HTML, and it's a direct result of the fix, so I updated the expected output in `tests/basic/backlash-escapes.html`. **Tests added:** - **`tests/test_extensions.py`, `TestSmartyEscapes`:** the case from the issue, escaped quotes in link titles, `\'`, and `\"` in ordinary text. - **`tests/test_apis.py`:** escaped characters added through `ESCAPED_CHARS` (`"`, `&`, `>`) come out escaped in both attributes and text, and the deprecated postprocessor warns but still works. **Test results:** `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests` stops before running anything on a clean checkout too. pytest can't collect `TestSuite` in `tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_md_in_html.py` because it has an `__init__`. So I ran the suite two ways: - **pytest on the touched test files** (`test_apis`, `test_extensions`, `test_legacy`): 235 passed, 69 skipped. - **The full suite with `unittest discover`:** 8 failures, all in the raw-HTML tests (`test_html_blocks` and `test_md_in_html`). The same 8 fail without my changes, so they're unrelated.
